title: ThemeFamilyContent
description: The content of a serialized theme family.

ThemeContent.description: The content of a serialized theme.

ThemeStyleContent.description: The content of a serialized theme.

border.description: Border color. Used for most borders, is usually a high contrast color.

border.disabled.description: Border color. Used for disabled elements, like a disabled playback control or button.

border.focused.description: Border color. Used for focused elements, like a keyboard focused track in the playlist.

border.selected.description: Border color. Used for selected elements, like an active playlist category or selected track.

border.transparent.description: Border color. Used for transparent borders. Used for placeholder borders when an element gains a border on state change.

border.variant.description: Border color. Used for deemphasized borders, like a visual divider between the sidebar and the track list.

conflict.description: Indicates some kind of conflict, like a track file missing on disk or a sync conflict in the music library.

created.description: Indicates something new, like a new track added to the library or a new playlist.

deleted.description: Indicates that a track or playlist no longer exists, like a deleted audio file.

drop_target.background.description: Background Color. Used for the area that shows where a dragged track or playlist will be dropped.

element.active.description:
Background Color. Used for the active state of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on.

Active states are triggered by clicking an element, or pressing the Play/Pause button or other activator.

element.background.description:
Background Color. Used for the background of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on.

Elements might include: Buttons (like Play or Pause), Inputs (like search bar), Checkboxes, Radio Buttons...

For an element that should have the same background as the surface it's on, use `ghost_element_background`.

element.disabled.description:
Background Color. Used for the disabled state of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on.

Disabled states are shown when a user cannot interact with an element, like a disabled player button when the queue is empty.

element.hover.description:
Background Color. Used for the hover state of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on.

Hover states are triggered by the mouse entering an element, or a finger touching an element on a touch screen.

element.selected.description:
Background Color. Used for the selected state of an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on.

Selected states are triggered by the element being selected (or "activated") by the user.

This could include a selected checkbox, a toggleable button that is toggled on (like Repeat or Shuffle), etc.

elevated_surface.background.description: Background color. Used for elevated surfaces, like a track context menu, popup, or settings dialog.

error.description: Indicates a system error, a failed playback operation, or an audio decoding error.

ghost_element.active.description:
Background Color. Used for the active state of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on.

Active states are triggered by clicking an element, or pressing the Play/Pause button or other activator.

ghost_element.background.description:
Used for the background of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on.

Elements might include: Buttons (like Play or Pause), Inputs (like search bar), Checkboxes, Radio Buttons...

For an element that should have a different background than the surface it's on, use `element_background`.

ghost_element.disabled.description:
Background Color. Used for the disabled state of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on.

Disabled states are shown when a user cannot interact with an element, like a disabled player button when the queue is empty.

ghost_element.hover.description:
Background Color. Used for the hover state of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on.

Hover states are triggered by the mouse entering an element, or a finger touching an element on a touch screen.

ghost_element.selected.description:
Background Color. Used for the selected state of a ghost element that should have the same background as the surface it's on.

Selected states are triggered by the element being selected (or "activated") by the user.

This could include a selected checkbox, a toggleable button that is toggled on (like Repeat or Shuffle), etc.

hidden.description: Represents a hidden status, such as a track being hidden in the library view.

hint.description: Indicates a hint or some kind of additional information, such as keyboard shortcuts for player controls.

icon.description: Fill Color. Used for the default fill color of an icon.

icon.accent.description:
Fill Color. Used for the accent fill color of an icon.

This might be used to show when a toggleable player button (like Repeat or Shuffle) is selected.

icon.disabled.description:
Fill Color. Used for the disabled fill color of an icon.

Disabled states are shown when a user cannot interact with an element, like a player button.

icon.muted.description:
Fill Color. Used for the muted or deemphasized fill color of an icon.

This might be used to show an icon in an inactive panel, or to deemphasize a series of icons to give them less visual weight.

icon.placeholder.description:
Fill Color. Used for the placeholder fill color of an icon.

This might be used to show a search icon in the search field that disappears when the user enters text.

ignored.description: Indicates that something is deliberately ignored, such as an audio file or directory skipped during library scanning.

info.description: Represents informational status updates or messages, like track scanning progress.

modified.description: Indicates a changed or altered status, like track metadata that has been edited.

renamed.description: Represents a renamed status, such as a playlist that has been renamed.

scrollbar.thumb.background.description: The color of the scrollbar thumb.

scrollbar.thumb.border.description: The border color of the scrollbar thumb.

scrollbar.thumb.hover_background.description: The color of the scrollbar thumb when hovered over.

scrollbar.track.background.description: The background color of the scrollbar track.

scrollbar.track.border.description: The border color of the scrollbar track.

success.description: Indicates a successful operation or task completion, like finishing a playlist export or a media library scan.

surface.background.description: Background Color. Used for grounded surfaces like a playlist panel or queue tab.

text.description: Text Color. Default text color used for most text, like track titles and artist names.

text.accent.description: Text Color. Color used for emphasis or highlighting certain text, like the currently playing track title or a matched character in a search.

text.disabled.description: Text Color. Color used for text denoting disabled elements. Typically, the color is faded or grayed out to emphasize the disabled state.

text.muted.description: Text Color. Color of muted or deemphasized text, such as track durations or album names.

text.placeholder.description: Text Color. Color of the placeholder text typically shown in input fields, like the search bar, to guide the user.

warning.description: Represents a warning status, like a network buffer underrun warning during audio streaming.

WindowBackgroundContent.description: The background appearance of the window.
